privacy.x: Effective date: January 4, 2026

48 Taxi & Limo ("48Taxi", "we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect personal information when you use our website at 48taxi.co, book a ride, use our Park & Fly service, call our booking line, or otherwise deal with us. We handle personal information in line with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).
1. Information We Collect
Booking and trip information
Your name, phone number, and email address.
Pickup, drop-off, and stop addresses, dates and times, and flight details for airport trips.
Number of passengers, luggage, booster or child seat needs, and any special instructions you give us.
Coupon codes, fare estimates, trip history, and receipts.
Park & Fly information
Vehicle make, model, colour, and licence plate.
Drop-off and return dates, flight details, and any add-on services you request (for example washing, detailing, or a battery boost).
Phone bookings

When you call our booking line, your call may be answered by an automated virtual assistant. We collect the information you provide during the call (such as your name, phone number, and trip details) to create and manage your booking. Calls may be recorded or transcribed for booking accuracy, quality, and dispute resolution.
Payment information

Payments may be processed by third-party payment providers. We do not store full credit card numbers on our website. We may keep limited payment records, such as the amount paid, date, and payment method, for accounting and tax purposes.
Business and agency accounts

For agencies, airlines, hotels, and other business partners, we collect contact names, business contact details, billing information, and passenger or crew details needed to provide and invoice the service.
Website information

When you visit our website, we and our service providers may automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device type, pages viewed, and referring website. See Cookies and Website Data.
2. How We Use Information
To take, confirm, schedule, and complete your bookings, including dispatching a driver.
To calculate fares and distances and provide estimates.
To contact you about your trip, such as confirmations, driver arrival, delays, and changes.
To process payments, issue receipts, and invoice business accounts.
To operate the Park & Fly lot and deliver any add-on services you request.
To handle lost items, complaints, and customer support requests.
To protect the safety of passengers, drivers, vehicles, and property, and to prevent fraud and misuse.
To improve our website, services, and booking systems.
To meet legal, tax, insurance, and regulatory obligations.
We do not sell your personal information.
3. Consent

By booking a ride, using Park & Fly, calling our booking line, or submitting a form on our website, you consent to the collection, use, and sharing of your personal information as described in this policy. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us, subject to legal or contractual limits. If you withdraw consent, we may not be able to provide some services.
If you book on behalf of another person (for example a passenger, guest, or crew member), you confirm that you have their permission to share their information with us for the booking.
4. How We Share Information
We only share personal information when it is needed to provide our services or when required by law:
Drivers: the driver assigned to your trip receives the details needed to complete it, such as your name, pickup and drop-off locations, and trip notes.

Service providers: companies that help us run our business, including website hosting, dispatch and booking software, email services, mapping and address services (such as Google Maps), phone and virtual assistant services, and payment processors. They may only use the information to provide services to us.
Business partners: when an agency, airline, hotel, or other organization books or pays for a trip, we may share trip, billing, and invoice details with that organization.
Legal and safety: when required by law, court order, or government authority, or when needed to protect the rights, safety, or property of our passengers, drivers, the public, or 48Taxi.
Business transfers: if our business is sold or merged, personal information may be transferred to the new owner under the same protections.
5. Driver Privacy & Third-Party Communications
For Agencies & Business Partners

For the privacy and safety of our drivers, 48Taxi does not provide drivers' personal phone numbers, addresses, or other private contact information directly to passengers, third-party agencies, or organizations.

If you need to contact a driver regarding a booking, passenger, pickup, payment, lost item, or any other matter, please contact 48Taxi Dispatch directly. Our dispatch team will communicate with the appropriate driver and coordinate the matter on your behalf.
This allows us to protect driver privacy while still giving agencies and business partners a reliable point of contact.
Any driver contact information obtained during a trip may only be used for that trip and may not be kept or used to reach the driver outside 48Taxi's official channels.
Call Dispatch: 902-789-7777 Email info@48taxi.co
6. Park & Fly Lot and Security Cameras

Our Park & Fly parking lot is monitored by security cameras to protect vehicles and property. Camera footage may capture images of people and vehicles in and around the lot. Footage is used only for security, safety, and investigating incidents, and may be shared with police or insurers when needed. Footage is kept for a limited time and then deleted or overwritten unless it is needed for an investigation or claim.
7. Cookies and Website Data

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to make the site work, remember your preferences, secure our forms, and understand how visitors use the site. Our booking forms use Google Maps services for address lookup and distance calculation, and Google may collect information under its own privacy policy. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, but some features, such as booking forms, may not work properly without them.
8. Storage and Transfers Outside Canada

Some of our service providers store or process information outside Nova Scotia or outside Canada, including in the United States. When this happens, your information may be subject to the laws of that country and may be accessible to its courts and authorities. We choose providers that use reasonable safeguards to protect personal information.
9. Retention

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, including legal, tax, accounting, and insurance requirements. When it is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.
10. Security

We use reasonable physical, technical, and administrative safeguards to protect personal information, including secure (HTTPS) connections, restricted access to booking and dispatch systems, spam protection on forms, and system monitoring. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
11. Your Rights
Subject to applicable law, you have the right to:
Ask whether we hold personal information about you and request access to it.
Ask us to correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete.
Withdraw your consent, subject to legal or contractual limits.
Ask us to delete information we no longer need to keep.
Make a complaint about how we handle your information.

To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to confirm your identity before responding. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.
12. Children

Our website and booking services are intended for adults. Rides for minors should be booked by a parent, guardian, or responsible adult. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children through our website.
13. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date. Please check this page regularly.
14. Contact Us
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to make a privacy request, please contact:
Privacy Officer, 48 Taxi & Limo Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada Phone: 902-789-7777 Email: info@48taxi.co

refund.x: 48Taxi & Limousine • Halifax Stanfield International Airport (YHZ), Nova Scotia

At 48Taxi & Limousine, we are committed to delivering dependable, professional, and on-time transportation. The following terms are designed to ensure clear expectations and fair service for all clients booking with us.
Cancellation Policy
More than 24 hours before pickup: Eligible for a 100% company voucher for future travel.
12–24 hours before pickup: A 25% cancellation fee applies. The remaining balance will be issued as a company voucher.
Less than 12 hours before pickup: A 50% cancellation fee applies, with the remaining balance issued as a voucher.
Refund Method

All approved refunds are provided exclusively as company vouchers for future transportation services. 48Taxi & Limousine does not issue monetary refunds, and funds will not be returned to credit cards, debit cards, or any other form of payment. Vouchers may carry an expiration date and must be presented at the time of booking.
No-Show Policy

A reservation is considered a no-show if the passenger does not meet the driver at the designated pickup location within the complimentary waiting period and cannot be reached. No-shows are charged in full and are non-refundable and non-creditable.
Waiting Time & Late Arrivals
Additional waiting time may be billed at the current hourly rate.
If a passenger cannot be contacted after a reasonable period, the trip may be classified as a no-show.
Flight Delays
When flight details are provided, we monitor arrivals and adjust pickup times accordingly. No additional charge applies for verified flight delays.
Service Rendered

Service is considered rendered once the cancellation window has passed, regardless of whether the passenger enters the vehicle. By confirming your reservation, you agree to all applicable rates, fees, and terms outlined in this policy.
Reservation Changes

Requests to modify a reservation must be communicated as soon as possible. While we will make every effort to accommodate changes, they are subject to vehicle availability and may result in additional charges.
Early Termination or Trip Changes
If a trip is shortened, interrupted, or modified after service has begun, no refunds or credits will be issued for any unused portion.
Lost or Found Items

48Taxi & Limousine is not responsible for any personal items that are lost, forgotten, or missing in our vehicles. If a driver locates an item and the customer requests its return, a delivery fee will apply based on the time, distance, and resources required to complete the return.
Shared Ride Circumstances

48Taxi & Limousine typically provides private transportation. However, in rare circumstances and due to operational needs, passengers departing from the same pickup location may be assigned to the same vehicle. In such cases, full fares remain applicable to each passenger. Drivers are not authorized to offer discounts, adjust rates, or provide partial refunds due to shared transportation.
Liability

48Taxi & Limousine is not responsible for delays or service disruptions caused by circumstances beyond our control, including but not limited to traffic congestion, accidents, weather conditions, flight changes, airport delays, or road closures.
Right to Refuse Service

Drivers reserve the right to refuse or terminate service to any passenger displaying inappropriate behavior, including intoxication, harassment, violence, or misconduct. In such cases, the trip will be charged in full.
Privacy
Your personal information is kept secure and confidential. We do not share client information with third parties except when required by law or when necessary to complete your reservation.
Acceptance of Terms
By booking or using our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these terms and conditions.
Contact Us
Phone: 902-789-7777 · Email: 48taxii@gmail.com
All approved refunds are issued as company vouchers only. No monetary refunds are provided.

cancellation.x: Validity: All issued vouchers are valid for 31 days from the date of issue.
Non-Cashable & Non-Transferable: Vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash, sold, or transferred to another person. They can only be redeemed for a 48Taxi service.
Single Use: Vouchers can only be applied to one trip. If the value of the trip is less than the voucher amount, the remaining balance cannot be refunded, credited, or reused.
Additional Charges: If the cost of your trip exceeds the voucher value, you are responsible for paying the difference directly to the driver.
Cancellations: If you cancel a trip or if a trip is cancelled after payment or deposit, the amount will be converted into a voucher (valid for one trip only, within 31 days).

truckAgreement.x: Property Address: 344 Sackville Drive, Lower Sackville, Nova Scotia
Between: 48 Taxi (“Service Provider”) and (“Client”)
1. Purpose of Agreement
This Agreement establishes the terms and conditions under which the Service Provider grants the Client the right to use designated areas for truck and trailer parking at the above-mentioned property.
2. Parking Location and Access
Parking spaces are located at 344 Sackville Drive, Lower Sackville, NS.
Parking is permitted only within designated areas assigned by the Service Provider.
Access to the premises is available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, unless temporarily restricted for safety, weather conditions, emergency condition or operational requirements.
The Client shall not obstruct entrances, exits, fire lanes, or other vehicles at any time.
3. Vehicle Registration and Identification
The Client must provide full details (license plate, make, and model) of all vehicles and trailers accessing the premises.
Both owned and non-owned commercial vehicles may be permitted, subject to approval.
The Client must promptly notify the Service Provider of any additions or changes.
Unauthorized or unidentified vehicles may be removed at the Client’s sole expense.
4. Term and Renewal
This Agreement shall commence on the starting date and continue a month-to-month basis.
The Agreement shall automatically renew each month unless terminated in accordance with this Agreement.
5. Fees, Deposit, and Payment Terms
Monthly fee for Truck: $350 CAD per parking space, plus applicable taxes.
Monthly fee for Buses, RV, Towing & Dump truck: $350 CAD per parking space, plus applicable taxes.
Monthly fee for All size Containers: $350 CAD per parking space, plus applicable taxes.
Monthly fee for one vehicle: $150 CAD per parking space, plus applicable taxes.
Payment is due in advance on or before the 1st day of each month.
A refundable deposit equal to one (1) month’s fee is required upon signing.
Deposit refunds will be issued within 15 business days following termination, subject to deductions for damages, unpaid fees, or violations.
Payments more than 7 days overdue will incur a $50 per week late fee.
6. Access Devices (Remote Control)
Remote access devices may be issued at the Service Provider’s discretion.
Fee: $45 per remote (non-refundable).
Deposit: $70 per remote (refundable upon return).
Lost, stolen, or damaged remotes will result in a $100 replacement charge.
7. Permitted Use of Premises
7.1 Parking
The Client may use the premises solely for parking commercial trucks, trailers & related vehicles.
7.2 Strict Limitation on Maintenance Activities

Only minor, non-invasive maintenance is permitted. This includes basic activities such as visual inspections, tire checks, or minor adjustments that do not involve tools, dismantling, or mechanical work.
Vehicle washing by mobile services is permitted, provided no environmental harm or drainage issues occur.
The following are strictly always prohibited:
Mechanical repairs of any kind
Engine work or diagnostics
Welding, fabrication, or part replacement
Oil changes or fluid handling/disposal
Any activity involving tools, equipment, or materials that may create spills, contamination, or safety risks

Any costs, damages, cleanup, fines, environmental charges, or repairs arising from any maintenance, washing, leakage, spill, contamination, or prohibited activity shall be the sole responsibility of the “Client”. The Service Provider shall bear no liability for such expenses, and the truck owner shall reimburse the Service Provider immediately upon demand.

The “Client” shall be solely responsible, at their own cost and expense, for immediate removal & lawful disposal of any leftover materials, parts, debris, or waste generated by or brought onto the premises, including but not limited to tires, tire remnants, scrap metal, pallets, packaging, containers, fluids, batteries, broken parts & any other discarded items. Any cleanup, hauling, storage, disposal, environmental fees, or related charges incurred by Service Provider due to the failure of the truck owner and/or operator to remove such items shall be reimbursed by the truck owner immediately upon demand.
The Service Provider maintains a strict no-repair policy. The premises are intended for parking use only, not as a repair or service facility.
7.3 Smoking Policy
Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the property.
8. Prohibited Uses
The Client shall not:
Store hazardous, flammable, or illegal materials
Conduct fuel transfers or refueling operations
Block traffic flow or emergency access routes
Abandon vehicles
Create excessive noise, nuisance, or unsafe conditions
Dogs are not allowed within the Parking lot.
9. Service Provider Responsibilities
The Service Provider shall:
Maintain general property conditions, snow removal, and basic upkeep
Provide reasonable access, subject to external conditions
Enforce site rules for safety and order
Disclaimer: The Service Provider does not provide security and is not responsible for theft, vandalism, fire, or damage.
10. Client Responsibilities
The Tenant shall:
Maintain valid insurance for all trucks, Containers and vehicles
Ensure trucks, Containers and vehicles are in safe operating condition
Keep the premises clean and free of leaks, debris, or waste
Ensure all drivers, employees, and contractors comply with this Agreement
Report any hazards or incidents immediately
11. Liability and Insurance
All trucks, Containers and vehicles are parked at the Client’s sole risk.
The Service Provider shall not be liable for any loss, damage, or injury.
The Clients agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Service Provider from any claims arising from use of the premises.
The Client’s must maintain appropriate commercial liability insurance.
Assumption of Risk and Indemnity for Injury:

The Client and/or operator acknowledges that the premises are intended solely for parking purposes and that entry to and use of the premises are at their own risk. The Client or operator shall be solely responsible for any injury, death, loss, or damage suffered by themselves, their employees, agents, passengers, contractors, or invitees arising from:
the use of the premises;
the parking, movement, loading, unloading, maintenance, or operation of any vehicle;
any prohibited activity under this Agreement; or
any act, omission, negligence, or misconduct of the truck owner and/or operator or their employees, agents, contractors, or invitees.

The Client and/or operator shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Service Provider, its owners, employees, and agents from and against all claims, demands, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, fines, penalties, and legal fees arising from any such injury, death, loss, or damage.
This clause shall not apply to the extent that the injury or damage is directly caused by the gross negligence or wilful misconduct of the Service Provider.
12. Default and Enforcement
The Client will be considered in default if they:
Fail to make payments on time
Breach any term of this Agreement
Bring unauthorized trucks, Containers and vehicles onsite
Cause damage or safety risks
The Service Provider reserves the right to:
Suspend or restrict access
Terminate the Agreement immediately
Remove or tow vehicles at the Client’s expense
13. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days’ written notice.
Upon termination, all trucks, Containers and vehicles must be removed within 48 hours.
Deposits will be refunded subject to:
Full payment of all outstanding amounts
Return of all access devices
No damages or violations
14. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Province of Nova Scotia.
15. Entire Agreement
This document constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions or agreements.
Any amendments must be made in writing and signed by both parties.
